## bluefin-cli theme

Show or set the Catppuccin flavor (auto, latte, frappe, macchiato, mocha)

### Synopsis

Show or set the UI color flavor.

"auto" (the default) picks Latte on light terminals and Mocha on dark ones;
naming a flavor pins it regardless of the terminal background.

```
bluefin-cli theme [flavor] [flags]
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help   help for theme
```
